row.team_price_text: Essentials: $240/mo billed annually ($2,880/yr), 1,000 MAUs, unlimited team members
row.evidence: Userflow's SAML SSO guide says users deactivated or removed in the identity provider 'are not automatically removed from your Userflow team'; SSO only creates accounts just in time, and no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: No SCIM, set by absence plus the SSO guide's explicit statement that IdP deactivation does not remove team members; SAML JIT creates the account but still needs an explicit invite. SAML SSO is on Studio and Enterprise per the pricing table (unticked on Essentials); the help centre says it 'may be offered as an add-on'. Pricing is per account by MAUs with unlimited seats: Essentials $240/mo and Studio $400/mo billed annually at 1,000 MAUs (the page's default view; digits are rendered by an animated counter, values read from its aria-labels), Enterprise custom. Accounts API (personal API keys) can list, update and remove members and create invites on every plan (500 req/min on Essentials). Okta OIN app is SAML only; Entra uses a non-gallery SAML app.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Price read from the animated price counter's aria-label (default Annual view, 1K MAUs); not quotable as text. SAML SSO icon disabled for Essentials in the comparison table.

plans.notes: Price read from the animated counter's aria-label, as above.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Custom; billed annually; talk to sales

limitations.text: Users deactivated or removed in the IdP are not automatically removed from the Userflow team; removal is manual in Settings > Team (or via the Accounts API).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the help-centre index or API reference. Lifecycle from the IdP is SAML JIT account creation only, without team access.

capabilities.notes: Members are added only by invite (POST invites); 'delete' removes the member from the account. create_user false: no direct member-create endpoint, only invites.

endpoints.purpose: Update a member's role and permissions
Remove a member from the account
Create an invite (name, email, role, permissions)

rate_limits.text: Per-account per-minute limit by plan: 500 requests/min on Essentials, 1,000 on Studio, custom on Enterprise.

user_api.notes: Two APIs: the Users API manages end-users of the customer's app (not Userflow seats); the Accounts API manages Userflow team members, invites and permissions with personal API keys.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML only (last updated Feb. 8 2021); its overview text mentions user provisioning, but no SCIM or provisioning capability (Create/Update/Deactivate) is ticked.

entra.notes: Userflow's guide sets Entra up as a non-gallery SAML app.

fallbacks.notes: SAML JIT creates the Userflow user but not team access; members still need an explicit invite (UI or Accounts API).
